title: 第十八章锦衣卫办案二第十九章锦衣卫办案三
content_zh:
张承业冤案昭雪后的一个月，长安城渐渐入了冬。第一场雪落下时，萧琰正坐在窗前，抄写着新借来的《史记》。屋内生了盆炭火，暖意融融，与窗外的白雪皑皑形成鲜明对比。张承业夫妇时常来探望他，有时会带些自家做的点心，有时会和他聊些读书心得，巷子里的气氛也恢复了往日的平和。萧琰本以为，经过上次的风波，自己能安安稳稳地备战秋闱，可他没料到，平静的日子并未持续太久。
那是一个雪后初晴的清晨，萧琰像往常一样去巷口买胡饼。王阿婆的胡饼摊前，围了几个街坊，正低声议论着什么。见萧琰过来，王阿婆连忙招手：“萧相公，你可听说了？昨儿夜里，东城的沈家当铺，出事了！”
萧琰心中一紧，接过胡饼问道：“沈家当铺怎么了？是遭了贼吗？”
“比遭贼还吓人！”旁边卖柴的刘叔压低声音，“听说沈掌柜一家五口，全没了！今早有人发现当铺门没开，撞进去一看，满屋子都是血，官府的人已经去了，连锦衣卫都来了！”
“锦衣卫？”萧琰手中的胡饼差点掉在地上。他刚从张承业的案子里脱身，对锦衣卫办案的场景仍心有余悸，没成想，短短一个月，又出了这样的大案，还惊动了缇骑。
“可不是嘛！”王阿婆叹了口气，“沈家在东城也算本分人家，怎么会遭此横祸？听说沈掌柜前几日还去西市买过布料，准备给小孙女做新衣裳，这一转眼，就……”她说着，眼圈红了。
萧琰咬着胡饼，却没了往日的香甜。他想起张承业案中那些冰冷的绣春刀，那些残酷的审讯，心中不由得生出一丝不安。沈家灭门案，死了五口人，案情必定重大，锦衣卫介入，怕是又要掀起一场风波。他暗下决心，这次无论如何，都要远离此事，专心备考。
可命运似乎总爱和他开玩笑。当天下午，他去书铺还书时，竟在书铺门口，撞见了一队锦衣卫。领头的人，他竟有些眼熟——那人身材挺拔，面容虽不如上次捉拿张承业的千户那般倨傲，却带着一股同样的冷冽，腰间的绣春刀在阳光下闪着寒光。
萧琰下意识地想躲，却被那领头的锦衣卫瞥见了。“你是萧琰？”那人开口，声音低沉。
萧琰心中一惊，停下脚步，拱手道：“在下正是萧琰，不知官爷有何指教？”他实在想不起，自己何时认识过锦衣卫。
“上月张承业案，你曾协助李侍郎查明真相，对吧？”领头的锦衣卫走近几步，目光落在他身上，带着几分审视，“我是锦衣卫指挥佥事陆峥，奉诏查办沈家当铺灭门案，有几个问题，想向你请教。”
萧琰的心沉了下去。他最担心的事，还是发生了。张承业案让他在无意中与官府、锦衣卫有了牵扯，如今沈家出了大案，锦衣卫竟找上了他。他想拒绝，可看着陆峥身后那些身着飞鱼服的缇骑，话到嘴边，却变成了：“官爷请问，在下知无不言。”
陆峥带着萧琰走进书铺，让随行的锦衣卫在门口等候。书铺老板见是锦衣卫，吓得脸色发白，连忙上前招呼：“官爷，您……您有什么吩咐？”
“无妨，你忙你的，我们只是问萧相公几句话。”陆峥摆了摆手，转头看向萧琰，“你常来这家书铺？”
萧琰点头：“是，在下备考秋闱，常来此处借书、抄书。”
“沈家当铺的沈掌柜，你认识吗？”陆峥问道，目光紧紧盯着萧琰的反应。
萧琰回想了片刻，摇头道：“不认识。只是偶尔听街坊提起过沈家当铺，说沈掌柜为人诚信，生意做得不错，从未见过本人。”
陆峥若有所思地点点头，又问：“最近一个月，你在书铺的时候，有没有见过可疑的人？比如行踪诡异、神色慌张，或者打听沈掌柜消息的人？”
萧琰皱起眉头，仔细回忆着。他每天在书铺待的时间不短，见过的人不少，大多是来买书、借书的书生，或是附近的街坊，似乎没什么特别可疑的人。就在他准备摇头时，一个身影突然在脑海中闪过——那是一个穿着灰色长衫的男子，大约三十多岁，面色蜡黄，眼神躲闪。前几日，他在书铺抄书时，曾见过这个男子。当时男子拿着一本书，却不怎么看，反而频频看向窗外，还向书铺老板打听“东城沈家当铺怎么走”。
“官爷，”萧琰连忙说道，“前几日，我确实见过一个可疑的人。那人穿着灰色长衫，面色蜡黄，向书铺老板打听沈家当铺的位置，而且神色慌张，不像寻常问路的人。”

陆峥眼中闪过一丝精光：“你还记得他具体是哪一天来的吗？除了打听沈家当铺，还说了什么？”
“应该是三日前的午后，”萧琰努力回忆着，“当时我正在抄《论语》，他进来后，先是在书架前徘徊了一会儿，然后就问老板沈家当铺的位置。老板告诉他后，他又问沈掌柜平日里什么时候在当铺，老板说沈掌柜一般都在当铺里，他听了之后，就匆匆走了。”
陆峥转向书铺老板，问道：“他说的是真的？三日前，确实有这样一个人来问过沈家当铺？”
书铺老板连忙点头，声音有些颤抖：“是……是真的！那人看着就不正常，我当时还觉得奇怪，现在想来，他该不会和沈掌柜家的案子有关吧？”
“有没有可能，你认识那个人？”陆峥追问。
书铺老板摇了摇头：“不认识！以前从没见过，看着不像是长安本地人，说话带着点南方口音。”
陆峥若有所思地摸了摸下巴，对萧琰说：“萧相公，多谢你提供的线索。若是你再想起什么，随时到锦衣卫北镇抚司找我。”他说着，从怀中掏出一块令牌，递给萧琰，“拿着这个，守卫不会拦你。”
萧琰接过令牌，入手冰凉，令牌上刻着“锦衣卫北镇抚司”的字样。他心中有些不安，却还是拱手道：“多谢官爷。”
离开书铺后，萧琰没有直接回家，而是绕到了东城。沈家当铺外，围了不少百姓，官府的人在门口守着，不准任何人靠近。他远远地看着那紧闭的当铺大门，心中五味杂陈。好好的一家人，就这样没了，而那个灰色长衫的男子，很可能就是凶手，或是凶手的同党。他提供的线索，能帮助锦衣卫抓到凶手吗？他不知道，只觉得这场风波，似乎正一步步向他靠近。
接下来的几天，萧琰一直心神不宁。他时常想起沈家的惨状，想起那个灰色长衫男子的可疑行径，总觉得自己应该做些什么。可他只是个书生，没有锦衣卫的权力，也没有查案的能力，只能在心中默默祈祷，希望陆峥能早日抓到凶手。
直到第五天夜里，萧琰抄书到深夜，准备熄灯睡觉时，突然听到窗外传来一阵轻微的脚步声。他住在巷尾，平日里这个时候，巷子里早已安静下来，不会有人走动。他心中一动，悄悄走到窗边，撩起窗帘的一角，向外望去。
月光下，一个熟悉的身影正从巷口走过——灰色长衫，面色蜡黄，正是三日前他在书铺见到的那个男子！
萧琰的心跳瞬间加快。这个男子怎么会出现在这里？难道他和陋巷里的人有勾结？还是说，他在跟踪什么人？
他没有多想，抓起外套，悄悄打开门，跟了上去。他知道这样做很危险，若是被男子发现，很可能会有生命危险。可他实在放不下心中的疑惑，也想为沈家的案子多提供一些线索。
男子走得很快，脚步轻盈，似乎对长安城的街巷很熟悉。萧琰不敢靠得太近，只能远远地跟着，借着路边的树木、房屋遮挡自己的身影。男子穿过几条小巷，最终停在了西城的一处破庙前。
破庙早已荒废，门窗破损，院内杂草丛生。男子左右看了看，见没人跟踪，便推门走了进去。萧琰躲在不远处的一棵大树后，心中犹豫着，要不要跟进去。进去的话，若是里面有同伙，自己肯定会被发现；不进去的话，就无法知道男子的目的，也无法获得更多线索。
就在他纠结的时候，破庙里突然传来一阵争吵声。声音不大，但在寂静的夜里，还是能隐约听到几句。
“……东西拿到了吗？”一个粗哑的声音问道。
“拿到了，”是那个灰色长衫男子的声音，带着几分得意，“沈家那老东西，嘴还挺硬，不过最后还是说了。”
“那就好，”粗哑的声音说，“赶紧把东西交给大人，免得夜长梦多。对了，你没被人跟踪吧？最近锦衣卫查得紧。”
content_en:
One month after the unjust case of Zhang Chengye was revealed, winter gradually entered Chang'an City. When the first snow fell, Xiao Yan was sitting in front of the window, copying the newly borrowed "Historical Records". There was a charcoal fire in the house, which was warm and cozy, in stark contrast to the white snow outside the window. Zhang Chengye and his wife often come to visit him, sometimes bringing home-made snacks, and sometimes chatting with him about their reading experiences. The atmosphere in the alley has returned to its former peace. Xiao Yan originally thought that after the last turmoil, he would be able to prepare for Qiu Wei in peace, but he did not expect that the peaceful days did not last long.
It was a clear morning after snow, and Xiao Yan went to the alley to buy Hu cakes as usual. Several neighbors gathered around Grandma Wang's Hu Cake stall, discussing something in low voices. Seeing Xiao Yan coming, Grandma Wang quickly waved her hand: "Xiao Xianggong, have you heard? Last night, something happened to the Shen Family Pawnshop in Dongcheng!"
Xiao Yan's heart tightened, he took the cake and asked, "What happened to Shen's pawnshop? Was it a thief?"
"It's more scary than being robbed!" Uncle Liu, who was selling firewood next to him, lowered his voice. "I heard that all five members of Shopkeeper Shen's family are dead! This morning, someone found that the door of the pawnshop was not open. When they rushed in, they saw that the house was full of blood. The government officials have already gone, and even the Jin Yiwei are here!"
"Jinyiwei?" The Hu cake in Xiao Yan's hand almost fell to the ground. He had just escaped from Zhang Chengye's case, and he was still frightened by the scene of Jin Yiwei's handling of the case. Unexpectedly, in just one month, such a big case would happen again, and Tiqi would be alarmed.
"That's right!" Grandma Wang sighed, "The Shen family is considered a decent family in Dongcheng, how could they suffer such a misfortune? I heard that shopkeeper Shen went to the West Market a few days ago to buy fabrics to make new clothes for her granddaughter. In the blink of an eye,..." She said, her eyes turning red.
Xiao Yan bit into the Hu cake, but it lost the sweetness of the past. He thought of those cold embroidered spring knives and those cruel interrogations in Zhang Chengye's case, and he couldn't help but feel a little uneasy in his heart. The Shen family was exterminated, and five members of the family died. The case must be serious, and if the Jin Yiwei intervened, it would probably cause another turmoil. He secretly made up his mind to stay away from this matter no matter what this time and concentrate on preparing for the exam.
But fate always seems to play tricks on him. That afternoon, when he went to the bookstore to return books, he unexpectedly ran into a group of guards in golden uniforms at the door of the bookstore. The leader looked familiar to him - the man was tall and tall, and although his face was not as arrogant as the Qianhu who captured Zhang Chengye last time, he had the same coldness, and the embroidered spring knife on his waist shone coldly in the sun.
Xiao Yan subconsciously wanted to hide, but was caught by the leading Jin Yiwei. "Are you Xiao Yan?" the man said, his voice low.
Xiao Yan was startled, stopped, cupped his hands and said: "This is Xiao Yan, I wonder if you have any advice?" He really couldn't remember when he had met Jin Yiwei.
"In the case of Zhang Chengye last month, you assisted Li Shilang in finding out the truth, right?" The leading Jin Yiwei took a few steps closer, and his eyes fell on him with a bit of scrutiny. "I am the commander of the Jin Yiwei, Lu Zheng, and I was ordered to investigate the case of the Shen family pawnshop massacre. I have a few questions that I would like to ask you for advice."
Xiao Yan's heart sank. What he was most worried about happened. Zhang Chengye's case inadvertently got him involved with the government and the Jin Yiwei. Now that a major case has occurred in the Shen family, the Jin Yiwei has come to find him. He wanted to refuse, but when he looked at the Tiqi wearing flying fish uniforms behind Lu Zheng, his words turned into: "My lord, may I ask, I will tell you everything I know."
Lu Zheng took Xiao Yan into the bookstore and asked the accompanying Jin Yiwei to wait at the door. When the bookstore owner saw that it was Jin Yiwei, his face turned pale with fright, and he quickly stepped forward to greet him: "Master, you... what are your orders?"
"It's okay, you're busy with your business. We just want to ask Mr. Xiao a few words." Lu Zheng waved his hand and turned to look at Xiao Yan, "Do you often come to this bookstore?"
Xiao Yan nodded: "Yes, I am preparing for the Qiu Wei exam, and I often come here to borrow and copy books."
"From Shen's pawnshopShopkeeper Shen, do you know him? Lu Zheng asked, staring closely at Xiao Yan's reaction.
Xiao Yan thought about it for a moment, shook his head and said: "I don't know. I only occasionally heard neighbors mention the Shen family pawnshop, saying that shopkeeper Shen was honest and did a good business, but I had never seen him in person. "
Lu Zheng nodded thoughtfully and asked, "In the past month, have you seen anyone suspicious when you were at the bookstore? For example, someone who is acting strangely, looking panicked, or asking for information about Shopkeeper Shen? "
Xiao Yan frowned and recalled carefully. He spent a lot of time in the bookstore every day and met many people. Most of them were scholars who came to buy or borrow books, or nearby neighbors. There seemed to be no particularly suspicious people. Just when he was about to shake his head, a figure suddenly flashed in his mind - it was a man in a gray gown, about thirty years old, with a sallow complexion and evasive eyes. A few days ago, he had seen this man when he was copying books in the bookstore. At that time, the man was holding a book, but he didn't read much. Instead, he frequently looked out the window and asked the bookstore owner "How to get to Shen's Pawnshop in Dongcheng."
"Master," Xiao Yan said quickly, "I did see a suspicious person a few days ago. The man was wearing a gray gown and had a sallow complexion. He asked the bookstore owner for the location of the Shen family's pawnshop. He also looked flustered, not like an ordinary person asking for directions. "
A glint flashed in Lu Zheng's eyes: "Do you remember the specific day he came? Besides asking about the Shen family's pawnshop, what else did they say? "
"It must have been the afternoon three days ago," Xiao Yan tried hard to remember, "I was copying The Analects of Confucius at that time. After he came in, he first wandered in front of the bookshelf for a while, and then asked the boss the location of the Shen family's pawnshop. After the boss told him, he asked shopkeeper Shen when he was at the pawn shop on weekdays. The boss said that shopkeeper Shen was usually in the pawn shop. After hearing this, he hurried away. "
Lu Zheng turned to the bookstore owner and asked, "Is what he said true? Three days ago, did such a person come to ask the Shen family pawnshop? "
The bookstore owner nodded quickly, his voice trembling: "Yes... it's true! That man looked unusual. I thought it was strange at the time, but now that I think about it, he couldn't be related to the case at Shopkeeper Shen's house, right? "
"Is it possible that you know that person? "Lu Zheng asked.
The bookstore owner shook his head: “I don’t know you! I've never seen him before. He doesn't look like he's from Chang'an, and he speaks with a southern accent. "
Lu Zheng touched his chin thoughtfully and said to Xiao Yan: "Xiao Xianggong, thank you for the clues you provided. If you think of anything again, come to Fusi, Jinyiwei North Town, to find me at any time. "He said, took out a token from his arms and handed it to Xiao Yan, "Take this, the guards won't stop you. "
Xiao Yan took the token and held it cold. The token was engraved with the words "Jinyiwei North Town Fusi". He felt a little uneasy, but he still held up his hands and said, "Thank you, sir. "
After leaving the bookstore, Xiao Yan did not go home directly, but went around to Dongcheng. Outside the Shen family's pawnshop, many people gathered around. Officials were guarding the door, not allowing anyone to approach. He looked at the closed pawn shop door from a distance, with mixed feelings in his heart. The good family was gone just like that, and the man in the gray gown was probably the murderer or an accomplice of the murderer. Can the clues he provides help Jin Yiwei catch the murderer? He didn't know, he just felt that this storm seemed to be approaching him step by step.
In the next few days, Xiao Yan was restless. He often thought of the tragic situation of the Shen family and the suspicious behavior of the man in the gray gown, and always felt that he should do something. But he was just a scholar. He did not have the power of Jinyiwei, nor the ability to investigate cases. He could only pray silently in his heart, hoping that Lu Zheng could catch the murderer as soon as possible.
Until the fifth night, when Xiao Yan was copying books late at night and was about to turn off the lights and go to sleep, he suddenly heard a slight sound of footsteps coming from the window. He lives at the end of an alley, and on weekdaysAt this time, the alley had already quieted down and no one was moving around. With something in his heart, he quietly walked to the window, lifted a corner of the curtain, and looked out.
Under the moonlight, a familiar figure was walking through the alley - a gray gown with a sallow complexion. It was the man he saw in the bookstore three days ago!
Xiao Yan's heartbeat quickened instantly. Why did this man appear here? Could he be in cahoots with the people in the back alley? Or is he following someone?
Without thinking much, he grabbed his coat, quietly opened the door, and followed. He knew that doing so was dangerous, and if he was discovered by a man, his life would probably be in danger. But he really couldn't let go of the doubts in his heart, and wanted to provide more clues to the Shen family's case.
The man walked very fast, his steps were light, and he seemed to be very familiar with the streets and alleys of Chang'an City. Xiao Yan didn't dare to get too close, so he could only follow from a distance, using the trees and houses on the roadside to block his figure. The man walked through several alleys and finally stopped in front of a ruined temple in Xicheng.
The ruined temple has long been abandoned, with broken doors and windows and overgrown weeds in the courtyard. The man looked around and saw that no one was following him, so he opened the door and walked in. Xiao Yan hid behind a big tree not far away, hesitating in his heart whether to follow or not. If you go in, if there is an accomplice inside, you will definitely be discovered; if you don't go in, you won't know the man's purpose and you won't be able to get any more clues.
Just when he was struggling, a quarrel suddenly came from the ruined temple. The sound was not loud, but in the quiet night, a few words could still be heard vaguely.
"...Did you get the stuff?" a gruff voice asked.
"I got it," the voice of the man in the gray gown sounded a bit proud, "That old guy from the Shen family was quite tough on his words, but he still said it in the end."
"That's good," the hoarse voice said, "Hurry up and hand the things over to the adults to avoid a long night of nightmares. By the way, you are not being followed, are you? The Jinyi Guards have been checking closely recently."
